The Diversity Visa lottery registration period runs for about one month in the fall, and it is free to enter. The exact window is set by the agency each year, so the fall timing is approximate until the official instructions are published.

The program is open to nationals of eligible countries. It is one of the few routes to a green card that does not require an employer or a family sponsor, which is why it sits on our recurring-dates page rather than in news coverage.

This is a reference date, not an announcement of anything new. Source: U.S. Dept. of State — DV Program. Nothing here is legal advice.

The date sits alongside the other recurring immigration windows we track:
https://immigrationclock.com/key-dates
